instant.comment: Press feedback and small toggles, such as a checkbox tick.

fast.comment: State changes in place: hover, focus and colour changes.

moderate.comment: Small elements entering or leaving: tooltips, menus, an expanding section.

slow.comment: Large surfaces entering or leaving: dialogs, drawers, sheets.

relaxed.comment: Decorative motion that should feel calm, such as a link underline drawing in. Pair it with the move easing.

deliberate.comment: Rare, emphasised moments that the reader should notice. Use sparingly.

standard.comment: State changes in place, such as hover and pressed.

enter.comment: Elements arriving on screen: they settle softly into place.

exit.comment: Elements leaving the screen: they speed up as they go.

move.comment: Elements that move or resize while staying on screen.

linear.comment: Continuous motion with no start or end, such as a spinner or a progress bar.
